weaknesses: The abstract does not clearly articulate the limitations of the proposed method, particularly regarding the generalizability of the results across different language models.
Claims of improved alignment with human texts need more quantitative support in the abstract; specific metrics and results should be briefly mentioned.
The relationship between the proposed method and existing decoding techniques is not sufficiently detailed, which may lead to confusion about its novelty.
strengths: The paper presents a novel framework, Daemon, that effectively addresses the mis-specification issues in language model decoding.
The theoretical guarantees provided for the optimization problem enhance the credibility of the proposed method.
Empirical results demonstrate the effectiveness of Daemon across various aspects of text generation, supporting its practical applicability.
